newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank rejects Bonn plan to revalue gold.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank rejects Bonn plan to revalue gold.

text.p: The German Bundesbank on Thursday issued a strong statement rejecting Bonn government plans to revalue its assets and demand an immediate payout of the profit booked from these hidden reserves.
German Finance Minister Theo Waigel two weeks ago announced plans to revalue the central bank's assets to give a much-needed injection of cash to Bonn's strapped public finances.
The central bank warned that this plan ran the risk of undermining the stability of the European single currency.
